title: Variance-based Friedgut coordinates
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$. Its variance-based Friedgut coordinates are the coordinates selected by the Friedgut coordinate construction for $f$ at error tolerance $\operatorname{Var}(f)/8$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function from $\{-1,1\}^n$ to $\{-1,1\}$
caveat: The definitions of the Friedgut coordinate construction and Boolean-function variance are not supplied.
